title: Visiting BAIC Foton Bus Plant: Intelligent Manufacturing Breakthrough
summary: BAIC Foton Bus Global Center Plant demonstrates intelligent manufacturing, modular bus assembly and cutting-edge bus parts for global market leadership.
content:
Under the spotlight of the intelligent upgrading of the manufacturing industry, the BAIC Foton Bus Global Center Plant was opened and showcased to global partners. At the same time, the Foton AUV Intelligent Bus made its global debut, handing out a brand-new business card for the high-quality development of China's bus industry with the dual hard-core strength of intelligent manufacturing and intelligent driving.

As an observer on the front line, China Bus Network went deep into the production heartland to witness this moment, which carries both industry milestone significance and market transformation value. The completion of the new plant marks that Foton AUV has set a new benchmark for intelligent manufacturing in China's bus industry with its full-chain intelligent processes and cutting-edge product technology.

## A Full-Range Intelligent Manufacturing Base

Entering the BAIC Foton Bus Global Center Plant, the most intuitive feeling is the wonderful fusion of quietness and speed. As a core intelligent manufacturing base painstakingly built by Foton AUV, it covers the production of the full range of large and medium-sized buses and mid-buses from 5.4 meters to 18 meters, encompassing five energy types: fuel, gas, hybrid, pure electric and hydrogen fuel.

## Modular and Flexible Final Assembly

Final assembly is hailed as the last key process of bus production. With modularization, intelligence and flexibility at its core, every process in the workshop is infused with the blood of intelligent manufacturing. The bus industry's first dual-vehicle AGV combined transport and SPS material distribution system is impressive: 45 sets of line AGVs and 36 sets of SPS AGVs act like well-trained dancers, coordinating with material carts to automatically adapt to different vehicle lengths and wheelbases, significantly improving assembly efficiency.
